_what_this_is: Agency-Greek style table for the render stage. skills/TRANSLATION.md tells the render model to follow it; pipeline/stages.py render_language_warnings reads it and REPORTS matches as non-blocking warnings in the render step's manifest entry (a blocking refusal needs owner approval). Values are generic agency-register preferences, never fixture content.
_owner: Bilingual reviewer / agency Greek editor. Proposed synthetic default — review before pilot use.
_status: Warnings only. The deterministic lint is high-precision and narrow; the human language attestation remains the Greek quality gate.

preferred_terms.why: One fixed rendering in every document; the agency writes the role in English.
«Καταχώρηση» is database vocabulary, not brief vocabulary.
«Αντίκρουση» means a rebuttal, not a contradiction.

preferred_terms.el: ο υπεύθυνος έγκρισης / η υπεύθυνη έγκρισης

preferred_terms.why: «Ολογράφως» means spelled out in words (for numbers), not written in full.

temporal_deixis.why: A brief is read days after the source was written. Name the meeting and its date instead (e.g. «στο kickoff της 3ης Μαρτίου»).

range_drift_why: A spoken hedge ('around sixty') must not widen into a decade range ('in the sixties' = 60–69) in either language.
organisation_names_why: Company names take the feminine article agreeing with «εταιρεία» («η Northlight», «της Northlight»). Glossary terms whose note says 'company' are added automatically.
